name: Nebuzar Adan
overview: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard under King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, played a pivotal role in the siege and destruction of Jerusalem, as recorded in 2 Kings 25. He led the Babylonian forces that burned the temple, the king's palace, and the city's great houses, and dismantled Jerusalem's walls, carrying away many inhabitants into exile while sparing the poor to tend the land. Notably, despite his harsh actions, Nebuzaradan also protected the prophet Jeremiah, demonstrating God's sovereign preservation even amid judgment.
